note: Public Monero nodes on their restricted RPC, each checked with a get_info that reports mainnet and status OK, get_fee_estimate, get_block_headers_range, a pruned get_blocks.bin read of one scan batch, and the full get_output_distribution.bin that a send picks its decoys from. The later rows come from the monero.fail, Feather, and Cake Wallet lists. Over TLS the client only accepts a CA-valid certificate, so the MoneroDevs, StormyCloud, HashVault, and xmr.support nodes (self-signed) and xmr-tw (expired) were left out. A plaintext node has to be added by the user, who also has to allow insecure access unless it's on loopback. Scanning runs locally with the view key, so the node never sees a secret, only which block ranges were requested. A user who minds that should point Jelly at their own node.
